mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.password, u.dept_id, u.email, u.phone, u.sex, u.avatar, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.del_flag = 0 WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.del_flag = 0

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.password, u.dept_id, u.email, u.phone, u.sex, u.avatar, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.del_flag = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = 0

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.password, u.dept_id, u.email, u.phone, u.sex, u.avatar, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM ( SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC ) AS user_ids INNER JOIN sys_user u ON user_ids.id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id ASC
